you already know which Taylor song is about who. we turned that instinct into a thread you can actually read — her discography as one honest timeline, every chapter in order, zero speculation 🤍

longlivets.com/?lens=love-story&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
altText: Fan photo from the Eras Tour, shared on r/TaylorSwiftPictures: Showgirl [3840x2160]
why: X sibling of the 10-19 Blank Spaces thread hero (see the IG item's why for sourcing and blocklist reasoning). Written first as its own post: one idea — the thread's premise, 'nine names before him' — the link, distinct vocabulary and first-five-words from the IG sibling so it clears the <80% cross-post gate. Same campaign + scheduledAt as the IG sibling; uncredited fan photo so no mediaCredit field. Non-themed family → photoEra unset. Experiment 01 TAGGED. Weighted length under 270, lyric-free. rulesChecked [L002].

experiment.hypothesis: A thread-hero post that teaches what the Blank Spaces lens IS earns more site clicks than our single-chapter love-story posts.
experiment.variant: Whole-lens origin/explainer framing instead of telling one chapter of the timeline.
experiment.metric: Site clicks (UTM) to /?lens=love-story vs. prior love-story chapter posts.

critique.rationale: Tight X teaser for the Blank Spaces thread: turns the fan instinct of 'which song is about who' into the thread's honest, in-order timeline, zero speculation. Structurally unlike its IG sibling; the photo is a real Taylor tour shot as the face of the catalog.
